title: $\alpha$-Graph: Attention-Infused Normalizing Flow Approach to Tractable Graph Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.07961v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph modeling, a crucial task for representing complex relationships in graph-structured data, has achieved significant success in recent years. However, current graph modeling methods rely on traditional Graph Neural Networks and pre-training approaches to implicitly learn the underlying relational structure of graph data. Thus, these prior methods cannot capture the complex graph structure and correlations among inputs. In this paper, we introduce a novel Attention-based Normalizing Flow-based Approach\footnote{Our implementation and models will be released publicly for research reproducibility.} (ANFA or $\alpha$) that provides an explicit, interpretable, and tractable Graph Modeling ($\alpha$-Graph). In particular, we propose a new Unconditional Graph Normalizing Flow with an Invertible Attention Mechanism to capture the complex relational structure of graph data. translated_title: α-Graph：一种注意力注入的可处理图建模归一化流方法
translated_abstract: 图建模是表示图结构数据中复杂关系的一项关键任务，近年来已取得显著成功。然而，当前的图建模方法依赖于传统的图神经网络和预训练方法来隐式地学习图数据的潜在关系结构。因此，这些先前的方法无法捕获复杂的图结构和输入之间的相关性。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于注意力的归一化流方法（ANFA 或 α），它提供了显式、可解释且易于处理的图建模（α-Graph）。特别是，我们提出了一种新的带可逆注意力机制的无条件图归一化流，用于捕获图数据的复杂关系结构。为了进一步增强模型的表达能力，我们引入了条件（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于注意力的归一化流方法α-Graph，通过可逆注意力机制实现对图数据的显式、可解释且可处理的建模，能够有效捕获复杂的图结构和输入间的相关性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes α-Graph, a novel attention-based normalizing flow approach that enables explicit, interpretable, and tractable graph modeling through an invertible attention mechanism to capture complex graph structures and correlations among inputs.
